issues.title: T7 no-start or no diagnostic contact from ECU supply/ground loss
issues.cause: Absent battery +30, ignition +15 or G7/ECU grounds disrupt ECU operation.
symptoms: engine ECU not reachable by diagnostic equipment
issues.diagnosis_summary: For MY2006 Trionic T7 4-cylinder, check prescribed supply fuses 17/27, maxifuse 2, ECU pins 23/43 and documented grounds G7 at ECU pins 25/47/62 before replacing the ECU.
issues.correction_summary: Restore confirmed fault in feed, fuse, connection or ground using WIS circuit and safe test sequence.
limits: No specific failure frequency or actual-car defect documented.
Do not assume failed ECU without testing supply, grounds and communication circuits.
Factory pin assignments are sourced to MY2006, not a universal cross-year guarantee.

issues.title: Crank/no-start or stall with missing CPS signal
issues.cause: Missing valid crankshaft position pulses may result from CPS, connector, wiring or related measurement faults.
symptoms: engine may cease running when position signal is lost
issues.diagnosis_summary: WIS P0337 during cranking and P0336 if crank reference is lost while running; measure CPS safely against temperature-scoped 860±90 ohm (20°C) and inspect proper signal and harness.
issues.correction_summary: Repair confirmed fault, without asserting every P0336/P0337 requires replacement sensor.
limits: No substitute CPS signal exists on this T7 4-cylinder source.
Resistance in range alone does not prove correct hot-running operation.
Full DTC workflow and condition-specific diagnostics still required.

issues.title: Engine no-start from TWICE immobilizer authorization
issues.cause: Missing/incorrect immobilizer authorization via TWICE can inhibit fuel injection, including after T7/TWICE/MIU replacement without required programming.
symptoms: engine cranks or fails to start
P1460 recorded in relevant Trionic T7 fault context
issues.diagnosis_summary: Check TWICE/T7 communication and immobilizer authorization using factory diagnostic tool. Distinguish this failure from missing ECU +15/G7 or failed CPS.
issues.correction_summary: Restore communication or carry out factory-approved programming after relevant module replacement, with authorized service tools.
limits: Do not conclude all failures to start imply immobilizer fault.
MY2005 replacement procedure separately sourced, not assigned as all-year step-by-step process.

issues.title: T7 ignition discharge power/combustion feedback electrical faults
issues.cause: Missing IDM main-relay power or wiring faults can interrupt ignition and feedback synchronization.
symptoms: P1310 or other ignition/combustion codes may be present
issues.diagnosis_summary: Trace main relay, G7, IDM feed and feedback pins 53/6; interpret P1310 vs combustion synchronization/misfire DTCs in their separate criteria.
issues.correction_summary: Repair verified power/ground/harness condition or correctly specified ignition module; do not substitute a red cassette in the cited 2006 T7 four-cylinder scope.
limits: No measured fleet-level cassette failure rate is established.
Catalyst-damaging misfires require prompt qualified diagnosis; misfire code alone not replacement proof.
High-energy ignition component: follow factory safety procedures.
